title: PROVISIONAL Phase-1 canonical claim record
$comment: PROVISIONAL. This is a Phase-1 contract pulled forward from Phase 4; the Phase-4 unit that supersedes it is ARC-0085. JSON Schema cannot express duplicate-of acyclicity or contradiction referential integrity; those rules live in command-center/p2-wave/probes/CC-0017/validate.py. Ranking and corpus-normalization are extension points (CC-0018, CC-0019), not this schema.
description: Stable claim id, canonical mechanism, duplicate-of / support / contradiction edges, source lineage, confidence, verification status, implementation impact, and the exact settling probe. Always-on settling_probe (not only UNVERIFIED). additionalProperties remains true so a receipt may carry schedule, migration, and reviewer blocks without a third schema growth.

claim_id.description: Stable claim id. Not a slug of the latest authoring agent.

canonical_mechanism.description: The proposition that would be true or false in the world, independent of who repeated it.

duplicate_of.description: Same mechanism, different wording or authors. Cycles are a validator error, not a JSON Schema keyword.

support.description: Independent evidence for a different mechanism.

contradiction.description: Target claim ids that cannot both be CONFIRMED. Dangling targets are a validator error.

confidence.description: Phase-1 closed vocabulary. Phase-4 ARC-0085 replaces this with Sherman-Kent bands.

schema_version.description: Instance version. Prefer 0.1.0-provisional until ARC-0085 freezes the family.

legacy_payload.description: Field-preserving round-trip pocket for pre-canonical CLAIM-REGISTRY records (CC-0012 migration contract).

extension_points.description: Named holes for later units. Do not grow required properties to fit an outlier record.

settling_probe.description: The EXACT settling probe. Mandatory on every record, including CONFIRMED.
